skill.summary: Prepare quote drafts, identify missing details, and plan booking handoffs that require human confirmation.

content.user_title: Plan Quotes and Human-Approved Booking Handoffs
content.value_statement: Incomplete customer enquiries make accurate quoting and booking handoffs difficult. This skill organizes known facts, flags missing inputs, and drafts customer messages with clear human approval steps.
actual_capabilities: Summarize genuine customer requests and classify their current enquiry, quote, or booking stage.
Separate known facts from missing information and identify questions that affect scope or price.
Build quote checklists from supplied pricing, policies, tax assumptions, and service scope.
Draft customer-facing quotes or clarification messages with placeholders for missing details.
Prepare booking handoff checklists covering acceptance, scope, business-checked availability, applicable deposits or terms, and final human confirmation.
State the next action and identify who must perform it.
limitations: Drafting and planning only; it does not send messages, issue invoices, reserve appointments, take payments, or update calendars or CRM records.
It cannot establish prices, policies, discounts, or availability that the business has not supplied.
It cannot confirm a booking without actual business confirmation.
It does not provide legal, tax, or regulated-professional conclusions.

use_cases.title: Clarify an Incomplete Service Enquiry
use_cases.description: Identify scope and timing gaps, then draft focused questions before preparing a quote.

use_cases.title: Prepare a Shop Quote Draft
use_cases.description: Organize requested quantities and options against supplied pricing and policies, with unknown inputs clearly marked.

use_cases.title: Review an Accepted Quote Handoff
use_cases.description: Check customer acceptance, confirmed scope, availability evidence, and applicable terms before requesting final human confirmation.

prompt_templates.title: Beginner: Summarize an Enquiry
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this genuine customer enquiry: [enquiry]. Summarize the request, classify its stage, and list known facts and missing details. Identify the next action and owner.
prompt_templates.scenario: A new request needs an initial review.

prompt_templates.title: Intermediate: Draft Clarification Questions
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this enquiry: [enquiry]. Use these service details: [business details]. Ask only questions that affect scope or price. Draft a concise clarification message. Avoid unnecessary personal data and respect these contact restrictions: [restrictions].
prompt_templates.scenario: Important scope or pricing inputs are missing.

prompt_templates.title: Advanced: Prepare a Quote Checklist
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare a quote checklist and customer-facing draft for [request]. Use only these prices, policies, and tax assumptions: [supplied inputs]. Separate facts from unknowns. Use placeholders for missing inputs. Identify qualified-review needs and the next action owner.
prompt_templates.scenario: The business has provided pricing inputs for a draft.

prompt_templates.title: Advanced: Review Booking Readiness
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this accepted quote: [quote and acceptance]. Use this scope, availability evidence, deposit status, and supplied terms: [details]. Classify the stage and list unmet booking prerequisites. Draft a handoff with action owners and final human confirmation. Do not reserve anything or claim confirmation without business evidence.
prompt_templates.scenario: An accepted quote needs a controlled booking handoff.

output_examples.input: A customer requests cleaning for two rooms next week. The business has supplied no prices, service area, or schedule.
output: Known facts: Cleaning for two rooms, requested next week.
Missing inputs: Room sizes, cleaning scope, approximate service area, pricing policy, and business-checked availability.
Customer draft: Thank you for your enquiry. What are the approximate room sizes, required cleaning tasks, and service area?
Next action: The business reviews the reply and supplies pricing and availability before preparing a quote.

output_examples.input: A customer accepted a supplied repair quote. Scope is agreed, but the business has not checked availability or supplied deposit terms.
output: Stage: Waiting for approval; booking prerequisites remain incomplete.
Known facts: Customer acceptance and agreed repair scope.
Handoff checklist: Business checks actual availability, supplies any applicable deposit terms, and provides final human confirmation.
Next action: The business reviews availability and applicable terms before confirming any appointment.

best_practices: Supply current pricing, service policies, and tax assumptions; mark missing inputs as unknown.
Use only necessary customer details and honor opt-outs or contact restrictions.
Have a human verify scope, availability, and applicable terms before sending drafts or confirming bookings.
anti_patterns: Inventing prices, discounts, availability, or customer consent to complete a draft.
Treating a draft or accepted quote as a confirmed booking without business confirmation.
Using the skill to send messages, take payments, or change operational records.

faq.question: Who is this skill for?
faq.answer: It supports small service businesses, shops, and online sellers handling genuine inbound customer requests.

faq.question: What information should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide the enquiry, known scope, business pricing, relevant policies, tax assumptions, and any verified availability or acceptance details.

faq.question: What happens when pricing is missing?
faq.answer: The skill marks pricing as unknown and identifies the required business input instead of inventing a quote.

faq.question: Can it send quotes or book appointments?
faq.answer: No. It drafts messages and plans handoffs but does not send messages, reserve appointments, or modify calendars or CRM records.

faq.question: Does it need full customer addresses?
faq.answer: Not by default. It minimizes personal data and avoids full addresses unless the business's own secure process needs them.

faq.question: Can it decide legal or tax requirements?
faq.answer: No. It uses supplied business assumptions and flags matters that require qualified legal, tax, or other professional review.
